first.speaker: The Archivist
text: Ah. A new entry. Come closer — the light is better for reading.
{player}. Fell from nowhere. Woke in the glade. Spared: {spared}. Erased: {killed}.
You're wondering how I know. I know everything that's forgotten. And you, {player}, have been forgotten very thoroughly.

echo_line.speaker: Echo
echo_line.text: Don't listen to it, {player}. We're not entries. We're people. ...Mostly.

clock_line.speaker: Clockmaker
clock_line.text: Old friend. You've been keeping time with dust for far too long.

alone_line.speaker: The Archivist
alone_line.text: No companions? Even your page is lonely.

final.speaker: The Archivist
final.text: Let us see how your story ends.

short.speaker: The Archivist
short.text: Back again. Let us read from where we left off.
